metadata.name: PersonalizeCard
metadata.description: With the inventory of preprinted cards, a User may send a post request with card number, account number, or admin number along with the customer PII data, address information, ID, and other required details to update a card account's customer records and register it with the customer. This allows a customer to instantly receive a card.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Clear Card Number of the cardholder Valid values: 0-9 Example: 123456******0001 Condition: At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: ProxyNumber
request_fields.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005 Condition: At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: Title
request_fields.description: Title for the customer Valid Values:  Refer Appendix Section : Title Values Example: Mr. Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: FirstName
request_fields.description: Cardholder First Name Valid Values: A-Z,a-z,special characters ( !@#$%^*()_+=-.) and Ampersand Example: Andrew Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: MiddleName
request_fields.description: Cardholder Middle Name Valid Values: A-Z,a-z,special characters ( !@#$%^*()_+=-.) and Ampersand Example: Charles Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: LastName
request_fields.description: Cardholder Last Name Valid Values: A-Z,a-z,special characters ( !@#$%^*()_+=-.) and Ampersand Example: Hudson Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SecondLastName
request_fields.description: Second Last Name Valid values are A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: Test Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: NameOnCard
request_fields.description: Name to be Embossed on Card Valid values are A-Z, a-z, and all special characters Example: Hudson M Charles Allowable Values: 28

request_fields.name: DateOfBirth
request_fields.description: Date of Birth of cardholder Format: MM/DD/YYYY Valid Values: 0-9 Example:- 03/26/1986

request_fields.name: MotherMaidenName
request_fields.description: Mother’s Maiden Name Valid Values: A-Z,a-z Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: CustomAccountID
request_fields.description: Any custom ID which is used to uniquely identify the Account. Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example:123456789 Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: AddressLine1
request_fields.description: Address Line 1 of the Cardholder Valid values : A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 15 Penang Street Point Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: AddressLine2
request_fields.description: Address Line 2 of the Cardholder Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 1 mecca way Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: Country
request_fields.description: This tag indicates the country of the cardholder. It should be 2 character code. Valid values :Valid values :A-Z, a-z Example: US Appendix Section: Country Code Values Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: State
request_fields.description: Cardholder State of residence Valid values are A-Z, a-z Example: GA Please refer Appendix Section : State Codes(US) Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: City
request_fields.description: Cardholder's City of residence Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: Norcross Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: PostalCode
request_fields.description: Cardholder Postal Code of Residence Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: 30093 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: HomePhoneCountryCode
request_fields.description: Home Phone Country Code Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 91 Refer Appendix section : Phone Country Code Values

request_fields.name: HomePhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Home Phone Number. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 9812338769 Condition: Mandatory when  WorkPhoneNumber or MobilePhoneNumber not provided Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: HomePhoneExtension
request_fields.description: Home Phone Number Extension Valid Values:0-9 Example:91

request_fields.name: WorkPhoneCountryCode
request_fields.description: Cardholder's work phone country code. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 91

request_fields.name: WorkPhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Cardholder  Work Phone Number Valid values:0-9 Example:9632581470 Condition:Mandatory when HomePhoneNumber or MobilePhoneNumber not provided Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: WorkPhoneExtension
request_fields.description: Cardholder's work phone extension code. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 1589

request_fields.name: MobilePhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Cardholder's Mobile Phone Number Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 9876543210 Condition: Mandatory when HomePhoneNumber or WorkPhoneNumber not provided Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: EmailAddress1
request_fields.description: E Mail Address 1 of Cardholder Valid Values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 @ . Example: sem_pp1 @gmail.com Condition: If the validation parameter is set on the product for Primary Email Address then it will be mandatory. Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: EmailAddress2
request_fields.description: E Mail Address 2 of Card holder Valid Values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 @ . Example :  sem_pp1 @gmail.com Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: SocialSecurityNumber
request_fields.description: Social Security Number of Cardholder Valid Values:0-9 Example:123456789 Condition:At least one of SocialSecurityNumber or IDName field should be passed in the input as Identification details. Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: IDName
request_fields.description: ID Code representing ID Name Valid Values: 0-9 Example 05 Condition:At least one of SocialSecurityNumber,or IDName field should be passed in the input as Identification details. Refer Appendix section : ID Name Values Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: IDNumber
request_fields.description: Last 4 Digits of Primary ID Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 4586 Condition : This field is mandatory when IDName is provided. Allowable Values: 18

request_fields.name: IDDescription
request_fields.description: Description of ID Valid Values: A-Z,a-z, 0-9. Condition:Field will be ignored in case of ID Name other than '13 - Other ID'. Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: IDIssuingAuthority
request_fields.description: ID Issuing Authority (country) Example : AE = United Arab Emirates Condition : This field is mandatory when IDName is provided. Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: IDIssueState
request_fields.description: ID Issue State Valid Values:A-Z,a-z Example:GA Appendix Section: Refer Appendix Section : State Codes (US) Condition : Mandatory when IDName is 07 and IDIssuingAuthority is US Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: IDIssueDate
request_fields.description: ID  Issue Date Format: MM/DD/YYYY Valid Values:0-9 Example: 03/26/1998 Condition : Mandatory when IDName is 02

request_fields.name: IDExpirationDate
request_fields.description: Expiration date of ID. Format: MM/DD/YYYY Valid Values:0-9 Example:03/26/1998 Condition : Mandatory when IDName is 02

request_fields.name: ShipToAddress
request_fields.description: Decision flag to decides address to ship a card. Valid Values: 2 : Same as Physical Primary Address 3 : Ship to Other Address Example: 2 Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: ShipToFirstName
request_fields.description: First Name for Shipping address Valid Values: A-Z,a-z. Example: TestName Condition : mandatory when ShipToAddress is 2 or 3 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ShipToMiddleName
request_fields.description: Middle Name for Shipping address Valid Values: A-Z,a-z. Example: MName Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ShipToLastName
request_fields.description: Last Name  for Shipping address Valid Values: A-Z,a-z. Example: LastName Condition: mandatory when ShipToAddress is 2 or 3 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ShipToAddressLine1
request_fields.description: Address Line 1 for Shipping address Valid values:A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 1 Meca Way Condition: mandatory when ShipToAddress is 2 or 3 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ShipToAddressLine2
request_fields.description: Address Line 2 for Shipping address Valid values:A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example:15 Penang Street Point Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ShipToCity
request_fields.description: City for Shipping address Valid values:A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example:Norcross Condition: mandatory when ShipToAddress is 2 or 3 Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: ShipToState
request_fields.description: State for Shipping address Valid Values:A-Z,a-z Example:NY Refer Appendix section :  State Codes (US) Condition: mandatory when ShipToAddress is 2 or 3 Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: ShipToCountry
request_fields.description: Country Code for Shipping address Valid values are A-Z, a-z Example: US Refer Appendix section : Country Code Values Condition: mandatory when ShipToAddress is 2 or 3 Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: ShipToPostalCode
request_fields.description: ZIP code for Shipping address Valid values:A-Z, a-z,0-9 Example: 30093 Condition: mandatory when ShipToAddress is 2 or 3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: UserFieldTitle1
request_fields.description: Field to capture additional data from cardholder as per product setup Format in case of date: MMDDYYYY Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: Test,1234,09102019 Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: UserFieldTitle2
request_fields.description: Field to capture additional data from cardholder as per product setup Format in case of date: MMDDYYYY Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: company Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: UserFieldTitle3
request_fields.description: Field to capture additional data from cardholder as per product setup Format in case of date: MMDDYYYY Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: company Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: UserFieldTitle4
request_fields.description: Field to capture additional data from cardholder as per product setup Format in case of date: MMDDYYYY Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: company Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: UserFieldTitle5
request_fields.description: Field to capture additional data from cardholder as per product setup Format in case of date: MMDDYYYY Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: company Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: CIPCheckConducted
request_fields.description: CIP Check is conducted on the card or not. Valid Values: 0 = Yes 1 = No Example : 1 Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: GeneratePlastic
request_fields.description: Flag to decide new plastic card number. Valid values: 0=Generates Additional card(Same Cardnumber), 1= Generates a  new Card(Different Cardnumber). Condition: works after product configuration

request_fields.name: IsCardMasked
request_fields.description: Flag to indicate CardNumber should be returned in masked form or in clear form. Valid Values: 0= Card Number without Masked in Resonse. 1= Card Number with Masked in Resonse. 2= No Card Number in Resonse. Note : Default value is 0 Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: LinkedAccountNumber
request_fields.description: To link an account with an existing account in the system. Valid values : Existing Account Number Example : 60000000009719 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: APIFunction
request_fields.description: Status of card during LN/OFAC check Valid Values : 0 = Normal Sell / PersonaliseCard 1 = Sell / Personalise Card from release approve panel Example: 1 Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: LinkWithExistingCustomer
request_fields.description: To link new account with existing customer using customer ID Valid Values: 0 = No(default) and 1 = Yes Format: x Example: 0=No,

request_fields.name: CustomerID
request_fields.description: Unique ID associated with Customer Valid Values: 0-9 a-z Format: xxxx Example: abc2123 Condition: Mandatory when 'Link With Existing Customer' = Yes Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: PlasticCode
request_fields.description: Plastic Code Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 32 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: WalletID
request_fields.description: Wallet ID of wallet mapped on account Valid values:0-9 Example:1005

request_fields.name: WalletLoadAmount
request_fields.description: Amount To Be Collected or Wallet Load Amount Valid Values: 0-9 Example:100.11

response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.
